# PR-A public SEC originals

Exact development reads on 2026-11-03. `manifest.json` preserves URL, actual fetch completion, original uncompressed SHA256 and size. No credentials, production configuration or account data. `original-receipts.json` points to already committed LI/PDD complete 6-K bytes and records a **new** independent public fetch; the older fixture manifests remain unchanged and retain their original UNKNOWN/offline-clock caveats. Directory/Submissions bind issuer and filing identity; CompanyFacts is parsed by the original Owner. CNY/USD convenience facts without original reporting-column proof remain ambiguous; observed common share counts do not prove current economic shares or corporate-action closure. Tests are offline and do not require developer SEC configuration.
